hooks.command: bash -c "if echo \"$CC_TOOL_USE_FILE_PATHS\" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cd $CC_PROJECT_DIR && cargo fmt --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi"

bash -c "if echo \"$CC_TOOL_INPUT\" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit|git\s+push'; then cd $CC_PROJECT_DIR && UNWRAP_COUNT=$(grep -rn '\.unwrap()' src/ --include='*.rs' | grep -v '#\[cfg(test)\]' | grep -v 'mod tests' | grep -v '// OK:' | grep -v '// SAFETY:' | wc -l); if [ \"$UNWRAP_COUNT\" -gt 0 ]; then echo \"BLOCKED: Found $UNWRAP_COUNT .unwrap() call(s) in src/. Fix before committing:\"; grep -rn '\.unwrap()' src/ --include='*.rs' | grep -v '#\[cfg(test)\]' | grep -v 'mod tests' | grep -v '// OK:' | grep -v '// SAFETY:'; exit 1; fi; fi"
